text:
zoe: Who put glitter in the communal makeup drawer?
mark: Not me. Unless it's the 'spark morale' initiative I didn't know I voted for.
isha: guilty. Tiny morale enhancer. I will replace with matte finish if it's a problem.
mark: It left a faint sparkle on my keyboard. Now my emails look celebratory.
printer-bot: FYI: toner cartridges unaffected by glitter. Please follow cleanup guidelines if you access shared drawers.
zoe: Can we have a glitter amnesty? Leave a note if you added sparkle so we can manage cleanup shifts.
isha: I'll volunteer to clean keyboards. Also offering tiny glitter-removal kits at the snack table at 3pm.
mark: GIF: <link_to_sparkle-woah.gif> caption: "accidental celebratory commit"
zoe: Resolution: glitter accepted with cleanup plan. If your keyboard starts shimmering, report for de-glitter support. Thread closed unless glitter migrates to the potted fern.
